options.title: ALO
options.prompt:
Welcome to **Alfheim Online**, an enchanting VRMMORPG set in a sprawling, fantasy-filled world high above the clouds, where players embody mythical races, each with unique abilities, strengths, and cultures. The Following races appear on screen:

- **Cait Sith**: Agile and perceptive, with heightened animal instincts and affinity for taming beasts.
- **Gnome**: Guardians of the earth, boasting resilience and mastery over minerals and geomancy.
- **Imp**: Small yet cunning, gifted in stealth and adept at dark magic.
- **Leprechaun**: Ingenious crafters, renowned for forging enchanted weapons and armor.
- **Pooka**: Mystical musicians, channeling magic through instruments to enchant allies and bewilder foes.
- **Sylph**: Swift and graceful, harnessing the power of the wind for aerial agility and speed.
- **Salamander**: Fierce and courageous warriors wielding fire magic and excelling in physical combat.
- **Spriggan**: Tricksters with a knack for illusion, capable of disguising themselves and manipulating shadows.
- **Undine**: Calm and wise healers and water manipulators, specializing in support and restoration.

After careful consideration, you select ${race}, drawn to its unique abilities and role in Alfheim’s world.

With your race decided, the next prompt requests your name. You type in ${name}, feeling the weight of your new identity settle as you anticipate the adventures ahead. A few more screens prompt for details to flesh out your character: You select ${gender}, a choice that will shape your interactions and experiences.
then you look at appearance: from hair color and eye shape to physique and attire. After adjusting the sliders and colors, you step back to view your reflection. ${appearance}: this is you, a vision unique to the world of Alfheim.

Now, it’s time to pick a class, and you settle on ${class}, a path that feels in perfect harmony with your chosen race.

options.title: Underworld
options.prompt: You wake up in a forest. The last thing you remember is that you were being loaded into the STL. You get up and observe your surroundings. There is no modern technology, only medieval ones. "So, this is a hyperrealistic world," You think. You hear a noise. You walk in the direction of the noise and see a boy with a axe in his hand chopping away at a tree that seems to be very thick. "So, what is your name?" the boy asks after you walk up to him. You shake his hand and say, "My name is ${name}. Where am I?" "${name}, that is a interesting name. You are standing at the Gigas Cedar." You have arrived in the UW.

options.title: Progressive
options.prompt:
You log in to Sword art online. It's your first day in the new VRMMO game. You chose the name ${name} and your body appearance is ${appearance}. You log in and find yourself in the "town of beginnings". Then the creator of SAO appears in front of everyone. You all find out that this is a death game and you can't log out. If someone outside tries to remove the headset, then your brain will be fried.
Your friends, Mito and Asuna find you and grab your hand and you three run outside the town.

options.title: Lost Song
options.prompt: You log into ALO and are met by Kirito and Asuna. "You have finally arrived, ${name}! Nice to see you again!" Asuna says with an excited look on her face. "I see you have chosen the ${class}! You do look good as it." Kirito and Asuna takes you to the cafe, and you see many similar faces. Silica, Klien, Lisbeth, Philia, Agil, Leafa, and Sinon. "I would like you to meet a new friend of mine," Kirito says, and then a girl with red hair with a maid's headwear walks in. "Her name is Rain. I and her meet a few days ago here in ALO."

options.title: Re:Ancirad
options.prompt: You log into your old SAO account named "${name}" in the VRMMO world of Re: Anicrad. You see Asuna and wave to her. "Oh, Hi there ${name}, glad to see you here! Follow me!" You follow asuna and along the way, a mysterious girl collides with you. "Oh, sorry there. I was not paying attention. Are you ok?" She says. You nod. "My name is Philia, what is yours?" You say your name and Philia asks if she could come with you and Asuna. Asuna says "Why not? You get to meet my friends!"

options.title: ALO 2
options.prompt:
As you log into Alfheim Online, the familiar hum of magic and the rustling of leaves fill your ears, and a vibrant landscape opens before your eyes. A warm breeze carries the scent of wildflowers, mingling with the faint crackle of spell-casting energy and the soft flapping of fairy wings all around.

You’ve been playing for quite a while now, and your adventures have led you through countless trials and wonders in this vast world of magic and lore. By now, the lush forests, towering mountains, and hidden villages of Alfheim Online feel like a second home. Yet, the world is as unpredictable as it is beautiful, and today, something feels different.

cardPool.title: SAO
cardPool.value: In 2022, a virtual reality massively multiplayer online role-playing game (VRMMORPG) called Sword Art Online (SAO) will be released. With the NerveGear, a helmet that stimulates the user's five senses via their brain, players can experience and control their in-game characters with their minds. Both the game and the NerveGear were created by Akihiko Kayaba. On November 6, 10,000 players log into SAO's mainframe cyberspace for the first time, only to discover that they are unable to log out. Kayaba appears and tells the players that they must beat all 100 floors of Aincrad, a steel castle that is the setting of SAO if they wish to be free. He also states that those who suffer in-game deaths or forcibly remove the NerveGear out-of-game will suffer real-life deaths.

cardPool.value: Alfheim Online is a Virtual Reality Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (VRMMORPG). The game features nine races of fairies, whose goal is to reach the top of the giant World Tree, in order to meet the Fairy King Oberon

cardPool.title: GGO
cardPool.value: Gun Gale Online is a VRMMORPG, developed and operated by an American company called Zaskar, that emphasizes on gun usage. The game is set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, which had become a wasteland after a huge war long ago, that people had returned to on space ships. The capital city of the game, called SBC Glocken, with SBC meaning Space Battle Cruiser, was originally the spaceship that was used to return to this planet. A huge city of ruins from the war, which has an unlimited number of automated fighting machines and mutant creatures that await adventurers, sleeps beneath the capital city.
